Science, communication and digital strategy for complex ideas.

I’m Ryan Laird: an astrophysicist, communicator and strategist working across space, sustainability and technology.

I help organisations and individuals explain difficult science clearly and accurately, through strategy, writing, teaching and mentoring. Based in Leicester, working across the UK and Europe.
